intro: {{nameA}} in {{cityA}} and {{nameB}} in {{cityB}} are two {{course}} options students often weigh together. This page compares their recorded fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
Noida International University vs IMS Noida is not a single winner. Compare fees, admission tests and the LLB classroom each campus offers.

sections.heading: Noida International University vs IMS Noida for LLB: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Noida International University if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹5 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹60,000, in a private LLB setting at Greater Noida.
Choose IMS Noida if you want a recorded fee of ₹1.07 lakh, in a private LLB setting at Noida.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹60,000 as a programme total for Bachelor Of Legislative Law (LLB) at Noida International University.

Our records show ₹1.07 lakh as a tuition figure for Bachelor Of Legislative Law (LLB) at IMS Noida. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Noida International University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹7 LPA on Bachelor Of Legislative Law (LLB). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for IMS Noida here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for Noida International University on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for IMS Noida on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Noida International University is in {{cityA}}, Uttar Pradesh, and IMS Noida is in {{cityB}}, Uttar Pradesh. A move between these cities should be part of the decision, not only the fee or the rank.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a documented flagship placement year, Noida International University is the clearer record here, because IMS Noida has no 2020-or-later flagship package on this page.
Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether IMS Noida's recorded ₹1.07 lakh or Noida International University's ₹60,000 fits your budget for this LLB.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Noida International University or IMS Noida?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Noida International University and IMS Noida differ in more than one way: they sit in different cities, so fees, tests and the move itself all matter.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Noida International University vs IMS Noida?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹60,000 for Noida International University on Bachelor Of Legislative Law (LLB); our records list ₹1.07 lakh for IMS Noida on Bachelor Of Legislative Law (LLB). Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Noida International University and IMS Noida?
faqs.answer: Noida International University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹7 LPA on Bachelor Of Legislative Law (LLB). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Noida International University and IMS Noida accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list no listed exam on this page for Noida International University, and no listed exam on this page for IMS Noida. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Where are Noida International University and IMS Noida located?
faqs.answer: Noida International University is in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, and IMS Noida is in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. Factor travel and hostel costs into the comparison.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
